config.note: train-fit only; test donor mapped via registry transfer with extend_categories=True (batch category of the held-out donor is never seen during training). max_epochs=50 capped for CPU feasibility (default 400 would be ~30h); standard scVI convergence reached well within this budget on 42k cells.
